tool.name: GninaSelectPose
tool.description: : Selects a single pose in the output of the gnina_run building block.

param.name: input_sdf_path
param.label: input SDF,GZ file
param.help: Path to the SDF file with the docked poses written by the gnina_run building block. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_sdf_path
param.label: output SDF,GZ name
param.help: Path to the output SDF file with the selected pose Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: pose
param.label: pose
param.help: Rank of the pose to extract, counted over the poses left after ligand has been applied and sort_by has been honoured.

param.name: ligand
param.label: ligand
param.help: Index of the ligand whose poses are considered, following the order of the ligands in the file gnina docked. All poses in the file are considered when unset.

param.name: sort_by
param.label: sort_by
param.help: Score to reorder the poses by before one is picked. The poses are taken in the order gnina wrote them when unset, which is already gnina's own ranking. Note that this reorders only the poses present in the file, so it is not equivalent to the pose_sort_order property of gnina_run, which reorders the whole internal pool before the redundancy filter and the num_modes cutoff discard poses.
